 Symbol

 ×

 Meaning
 Mother
 Brother
 Wife
 Father
 
 

 

Given: B + R × I − T ÷ H

It means: B is the mother of R, R is the wife of I, I is the brother of T and T is the father of H.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7175ad824bdaeb539316d3b1762ef2ce50717d51b0b8911cd409d8d48cfb0dfb.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95597e84a933b0f722efd08ba477531f4b306cbebc9692791ae8c4e2695c25a5.png] 

S, I is the **Father’s brother **of H.

Hence, the correct answer is "Father’s brother".
